0022600208.text: The Denver Nuggets, 5-3 and on a two-game winning streak, visit the Houston Rockets, who are 7-2, first in the Southwest, and coming off a one-game losing streak. Denver is fourth in the Northwest, 1.5 games back, and ninth in the West, with a 3-1 road record, while Houston is 4-1 at home and second in the West. Julian Strawther is out for Denver with a knee sprain, Clint Capela and Steven Adams are out for Houston with an ankle sprain and a calf strain, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after Denver won the 2025-26 series 3-1 and beat Houston 129-93 in their last meeting in Denver.
